scope.contract: Original I-005 / s3 supplementary rule: captions default to clipLocal and follow their host clip. This slice admits already-schemaed clipLocal caption anchors (clipId + clip-local range fully inside the host media clip) and translates those cues with the host on MoveClips, including later hosts shifted by insert-move, and all three collision modes. Imported and newly added cues stay absolute until the user anchors them. Absolute cues stay at authored times. Source anchors, styles, words and speakers remain CAPTION_RICH_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED on writable admission. Insert paste and ripple delete/trim/close still refuse when a cue would need crop/split or a later shift via CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. MP4 text burn-in remains CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; sidecar export is used. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, marker business, and I-006 remain closed. No new persistence table.
scope.temporalSemantics: clipLocal cue.timelineRange.start = host.timelineStart + anchor.range.start; duration equals the stored clip-local duration. Moving the host (or a later insert-move shift of that host) rewrites only the cue timeline start and bumps the cue version; text, language, manual fields and the stored local range are unchanged. A cue that would no longer fit the host duration refuses ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE wholly. A missing host refuses CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. includeLinks=false follows only the moved host. Making a cue absolute stops follow on the next move. Locked selected hosts still FIELD_LOCKED for the whole group.
scope.preserved: Leave-gap delete/trim, single-range ripple delete and close, shorten and lengthen ripple trim, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, and insert-move leave-gap remain distinct. Whole-group atomic refusal. Writer-fence / revision / SQL trigger rollback unchanged.
scope.history: Anchor is one SetCaptions command; follow happens inside the existing MoveClips command. Journal undo/redo, save, reopen, archive fork, and VTT sidecar export are on existing paths.
scope.ui: Workbench Caption editor (caption-panel): Anchor selected cue to covering clip and Make selected cue absolute. New/imported cues stay absolute. The unique covering video clip is preferred when both video and audio cover the cue.
